title: Trump's proposed 'Golden Fleet' warships could cost $275 billion, says CBO
summary: The Congressional Budget Office (CBO) has estimated that former U.S. President Donald Trump's proposed "Golden Fleet" of battleships could cost up to $275 billion. This proposal involves building a new class of battleships. The CBO's estimate indicates these would be the most expensive warships ever constructed.
summary_points: The Congressional Budget Office (CBO) estimated the cost of Trump's proposed 'Golden Fleet' at up to $275 billion.
The proposal involves building a new class of battleships.
The CBO's estimate suggests these would be the most expensive warships ever built.
